title: Active Euthanasia, ALS, and Fundamental Human Rights

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: In 2023–2024, Hungarian constitutional lawyer Dr. Dániel Karsai, suffering from terminal ALS, ignited historic national discourse by taking his fight for assisted dying to the European Court of Human Rights and the Constitutional Court.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Karsai argued that criminalizing assistance to end one's life abroad deprives patients of the right to make the ultimate decision about their own bodily suffering, violating Article 8 of the European Convention.
